M207 stores a legal four-descriptor per-bank packet sum of up to 48 in five bits; truncation can underflow the bank ledger and deadlock. The 92,878,814 cycles and 1.234355878 factor may be retained only as a historical non-truncating opportunity model. The repository revocation is correct.
